checks.name: Real authenticated REVEX project and model load without an error overlay
Independent Google authorization preserves LIBER identity, removes unused scope, and never automatically selects LIBER billing
Project access is checked without generating; image prices follow resolution; billing links go directly to Google
Depleted-credit failure is readable, uses selected customer project, and never retries or falls back to LIBER billing
Render controls fit 320–1440px widths and primary button has contrasting colors
Changing Google account clears the checked billing state and does not generate
A current run is distinguished from old failure artifacts, which stay collapsed
Long Energy report filenames and metadata remain contained across all six widths
The completed current result replaces the previous-attempt presentation
Geometry adjustments remain an explicit review requirement after successful calculations
Public OAuth landing page explains LIBER and links privacy and terms without login
